suggestion.moveText: Move part of the text to another slide or to the caption.
suggestion.hookCover: Keep only the promise or the question on the cover; the rest goes on the following slides.
suggestion.ctaMissing: Use a closing layout with a CTA or fill in the CTA slot.
suggestion.provenClaim: Use an approved claim with its proof, or rephrase without absolutes.
suggestion.removePrice: Remove the price or ask for it in the brief.
suggestion.productData: Use only the data of the approved product.
suggestion.thumbnail: Shorten the cover title and use a larger font size.
suggestion.largerImage: Use a larger image or a smaller slot.
suggestion.approveOrReplace: Approve the image or replace it.
suggestion.shortenText: Shorten the text or choose a layout with more space.
suggestion.useRoleOverlay: Use the “{role}” role{onImage, select, yes { or add the layout overlay} other {}}.
suggestion.addOverlay: Add the layout overlay or change the image.

notRun.reviewer: Vague hook, tone, topics to avoid as a theme and product facts without numbers need the Reviewer agent.

errors.brandVersionNotApproved: The given Brand Identity version is not approved.
errors.brandNotPublished: The client has no published Brand Identity: the checks have no approved rules.
errors.findingNotFound: Finding not found in the latest check.
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 280 characters.
errors.errorNotIgnorable: Errors cannot be ignored: fix them or confirm them with “I’ve seen it”.
errors.checksNotRun: The checks have not run yet.
errors.checksStale: The checks are not up to date with the latest version: run them again.
errors.aiImagesPending: There are AI images waiting for approval.
errors.checksNotAcknowledged: Confirm every open error and warning with “I’ve seen it”.
